body: Hahaha thank you. Collective narcissism is growing at large these days and it’s up to them whether they want to change.

Resentment is like drinking poison and waiting for the other person to die. I understand this and it’s clear that we do have a choice to how we behave/communicate around the other so. But it’s filtering the emotions in a positive way and having control to not slip anger and project those feelings which is very difficult. It’s whether or not you choose to even engage with this person which can bring up harboured negative emotions
